# hub-mcp

> Stdio MCP server that lets an AI assistant (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, any MCP client) operate an academy hub — cohorts, courses and lessons, instructors, leads, drip email, memberships and venue events — through the hub's authenticated internal API. Writes are previewed before they commit. MIT.

The hub itself is at https://github.com/AiStartAcademy/hub. Rules for coding agents are in AGENTS.md.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): install from source, configuration, client setup for Claude Code and Claude Desktop, full tool list, hub-side setup, security
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): layout, rules and the add-a-tool recipe for coding agents
- [CONTRIBUTING](CONTRIBUTING.md): how to propose changes
- [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md): release notes
